abstract: A 33-year-old woman whose left ovarian dysgerminoma had been resected presented with left axillar swelling and a right breast tumor about three years after surgery. Histological examination of the mastectomized tumor revealed primary infiltrating carcinoma into the muscle layer and a metastatic ovarian dysgerminoma showing well-defined proliferation. Despite chemotherapy, she died 7 months later of breast cancer. To our knowledge, this is the only reported case of its kind in the world literature.
abstract_ja: 33歳女性。左卵巣未分化胚細胞腫を切除後約3年で、左腋窩の腫脹と右乳房の腫瘍が出現した。乳房切除標本の組織学的検討では、筋層に浸潤する原発性浸潤性乳癌と、明瞭な増殖を示す転移性卵巣未分化胚細胞腫が認められた。化学療法にもかかわらず、7か月後に乳癌で死亡した。このような症例は、世界の文献上これまでに唯一の報告である。
